# Phase 2 Second Review Directive: Candidate Workspace & Navigation (DIR-030)
**Governing Protocol:** SKILL.md v10.0 (AI Bridge Supervisor Master Edition)
**Execution Schedule:** Sequenced immediately after DIR-029 in the Post-DIR-028 Second Review Pipeline.
**Target Directives for Re-Audit:** DIR-002, DIR-004, DIR-009, DIR-011.

## 1. Objective & Scope
Re-evaluate and perform deep second review on Candidate Workspace, Navigation Header, Zero-FOUC Hydration, and Sub-Surfaces against v10.0 rules.

## 2. Mandatory Verification Gates
1. **§19 Zero-FOUC & Hydration Quality:** Hard refresh on candidate routes must exhibit 0ms theme/font flashing.
2. **§21.1 Token Grounding:** 100% Cuba executive token grounding on CubaCandidateHero, stat cards, action buttons, and command palette.
3. **§22 WCAG 2.2 AA:** Nav landmarks, focus visibility, keyboard navigation.
4. **§2 Level 5 Playwright E2E:** Full verification against live MariaDB.
invariants: INV-1: Resume Templates & ATS Engine strictly 0-byte diff.
INV-2: Zero-FOUC & instant theme hydration: Initial state must never flash unstyled content or default colors on hard refresh.
INV-3: Universal AppHeader command surface must preserve 100% backward compatibility for all portal shells.
acceptanceCriteria: §19 Zero-FOUC & Hydration Quality: Zero theme flashing or layout shift on hard reload across /dashboard, /dashboard/resumes, and /dashboard/jobs.
§21.1 100% Token Grounding: Verify candidate hero, stat cards, quick pitch buttons, and resume grid cards strictly use Cuba semantic tokens. 0 legacy utility residue.
§22 Accessibility & Landmark Semantics: Unique <nav aria-label='Candidate workspace navigation'>, visible keyboard focus rings on all interactive elements, and zero focus traps in modal dialogs.
§2 Level 5 Playwright E2E Suite: All candidate navigation journeys, context switcher transitions, and resume actions pass with 100% green tests against live MariaDB.
